audit.why: Renekton owning 1-3 and 6 with Akali taking 4-5 and both item stages matches 49.49% Emerald+ over 3504 games and both on-disk charts. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was untouched template text and never named Dominus; breakdown.spikes gave Akali 'levels 2-3'.
audit.why: Dominus is 120/100/80s and, crucially, generates Fury periodically while it runs - so his level 6 is not just bonus health, it is a window where he can chain empowered Ruthless Predators back to back. Twilight Shroud is also not learnable before level 3.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, phases[0].why, breakdown.spikes and breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt on Dominus' 120s and Fury generation, and on level 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Reign of Anger is never described, and the empowered-W warnings sold it on 'destroys shields' — a clause with no bearing on Akali, who has no shield in her kit.
audit.why: The interaction that actually decides this lane is that Reign of Anger generates MORE Fury the lower Renekton's health is. That inverts the normal read: a Renekton you have chipped to a sliver reaches 50 Fury faster and gets the empowered stun back first, so the moment he looks killable is the moment his stun goes from 0.75s to 1.5s. The shield-destruction clause, by contrast, is a non-interaction here and was taking up the space that number should have had.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, breakdown.cooldowns and content whys[2], whys[4] and wants.foe[0] now carry the low-health Fury acceleration and the 0.75s-to-1.5s stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dominus carried no cooldown and the stun durations were never given.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator 16/14/12/10/8s, Slice and Dice 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Cull the Meek a flat 7s, Dominus 120/100/80s. The stun going 0.75s to 1.5s at 50 Fury is the difference between surviving his combo and not.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d and report[9].t now state them.

audit.why: Plated Steelcaps and early Grievous Wounds are both right: his damage is physical and Cull the Meek heals him on a flat 7s. Left alone.

notes: The old copy leaned on empowered Ruthless Predator 'destroying damage shields'. Akali has no shield anywhere in her kit, so that clause was a non-interaction on this page; I replaced it with the stun-duration jump and the low-health Fury acceleration, which are the parts that actually change how you play the lane.
